title: OpenUI $state persistence, verified in a real browser

environment.dsh: booted from the installed runtime, profile p3web
environment.profile: p3web — isolated DSH_HOME at tmp/dsh-p3; production desktop (:61582) untouched
environment.browser: Chromium Agent Window (browser-skill over CDP), session acbm
environment.isolationCheck: The production profile installs the published @nagi-ovo/dsh-visualize@^0.1.7, not this tree; the isolated profile installs file:D:/work/dsh-plugin-visualize and names @dsh-unified/visualize as its only visualisation bundle.

checks.name: replay after reload — the case stage 2 marked PARTIAL
checks.detail: The model drew an OpenUI card with Slider($count, 1, 10, 1, "count") and Text("count " + @Format($count, "number")). Dragging the Slider 3 -> 6 changed the sibling to "count 6". After reload the card came back with value 6 and text "count 6", not the program default 3.

checks.name: the record is written under the :openui key with the A′ payload
checks.detail: One localStorage entry, key ending ":openui", payload {t, s:{v:1, h:"18bcb949", values:{count:6}}}. No HTML-shaped entry was created for this card.

checks.name: the value survives repeated reloads, not just one
checks.detail: Reloaded the page twice more and reopened the session once; the Slider still read 6 and the stored t stayed at the first write (1793634317341), so nothing rewrote or churned the record.
checks.detail2: The second reload landed on the session list; after reopening the session the card restored to 6 again.

checks.name: the hash is stable across reloads
checks.detail: h stayed "18bcb949" across all three loads, so a reload does not look like a schema change and does not migrate the state.

checks.name: the session id reaches the openui card
checks.detail: The stored key begins with the real session id (session-82ee260c-9ed6-44b5-9909-b9adf7599c3c), which is only possible because the intelligent_ui toolview received it (P3-04). Before that change the same card would have persisted nothing.

checks.name: cross-card and cross-session isolation, in the browser
checks.detail: Covered by unit tests (tests/openui-state.spec.tsx cases 6 and 7) but not driven in the browser: only one card was drawn, because a second model call was not made.

checks.name: corrupt localStorage falls back safely, in the browser
checks.detail: Covered by unit tests (case 15, and the throwing-storage case 9) but not exercised on a live page.

captureNotes.whyTheCardIsNotInEveryScreenshot: The host folds a finished turn with an ancestor carrying `content-visibility: hidden`. A subtree that is laid out but skipped for painting also drops out of the accessibility tree, so getBoundingClientRect returned 675x79 while the card appeared in neither the a11y snapshot nor a viewport capture.
captureNotes.whatWasDone: For the final capture (s16) `content-visibility` was forced to visible on the two host fold containers, then reverted (s17). The persisted record was unchanged by the override: t and h are identical before and after.
captureNotes.pluginOrHost: Host behaviour. No plugin code was changed, disabled or special-cased to produce the image, and the measurement in S04/P301 does not depend on the override at all.

notVerifiedOverall: Button action steps remain inert: only Slider writes state, so a Button-driven state change is stubbed by the unit tests but not exercisable in the UI yet.
The HTML backend's own card state in this build was not re-driven in the browser; it is covered by the existing 25 unit tests, which pass unchanged.
